root_cause: XTerm.NET 1.0.15 APC parser never exits on ST after the OpenTUI Kitty graphics capability query; all later screen output was swallowed.
before_fix: The real OpenCode terminal UI test failed with a screen containing only a backslash.
fix: Streaming removal of unsupported DCS/SOS/PM/APC control strings before VT parsing; bounded memory and split-sequence support; existing history query suppression preserved.

native_ui_test.command: STYLOAGENT_LIVE_OPENCODE=1 dotnet test tests/Styloagent.UITests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~OpenCodeStartupTests
checks: Late UI attachment paints the real OpenCode screen
TextInput reaches the real native TUI and appears in the rendered screen
Detach/reattach restores the screen and typed input

desktop_check.result: Restarted the actual desktop app and visually confirmed OpenCode session content and input box render.

limits: The desktop and native UI checks ran on macOS arm64.
Windows and Linux native UI behavior not live-tested.
Earlier native adapter provider tests were not repeated for the terminal-only change.
